about.label: About
about.bioParagraph1: Hi, I'm Abdul Muid, an Informatics Engineering student at Politeknik Negeri Malang. My strength is interface design, and I enjoy taking a design all the way to a working web app, from Figma to code.
about.bioParagraph2: To me, good products come from clear communication. I listen closely to what people need, explain ideas simply, and bridge designers, developers, and non-technical teammates so everyone moves in the same direction.

faq.label: 06 · FAQ
faq.subtitle: [PLACEHOLDER] Key details regarding internship availability, collaboration style, and tech preferences.

items.question: What is your primary tech stack?
items.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] On the frontend, I focus on React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. For backend and databases, I work with Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. For product research and interface design, Figma is my go-to tool.

items.question: Are you available for on-site internships in Malang or remote?
items.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Yes, I am based in Malang and open to on-site internships locally, as well as hybrid or full-remote roles for companies located elsewhere.

items.question: How do you approach team collaboration?
items.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] I value clear, proactive communication. I am accustomed to Git workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews), task management tools, and writing concise technical documentation.

items.question: What is your workflow when converting designs into code?
items.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] I deconstruct Figma designs into systematic tokens (color, typography, spacing), construct modular components, and build them using Tailwind CSS and Next.js with pixel-perfect precision and responsiveness.

items.question: What is the best way to contact you?
items.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] You can reach me through the contact form below, via direct email, or on LinkedIn. I typically respond within 24 hours on business days.

items.question: What types of tasks or projects are you most eager to tackle?
items.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] I thrive when working on interactive frontend systems, slicing complex UI/UX designs, integrating APIs, and building end-to-end features for MVP-stage web applications.
